description: Nested aligned queries preserve synthetic reads without duplicating restoration records (engine §4 and §7).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%rule text a | b | c
%rule a X [+T]
%rule b X [+T] [+U]
%rule c $x(body)
%conditions matches(without-elision($x), rival)
%rule body X T
%rule rival $y(original)
%conditions matches(without-elision($y), inner)
%rule original X [+T]
%rule inner X [+T]
